objective: 请对当前 Quant 系统进行一次**从真实可运行闭环出发的全面审查、重构、验证与持续优化**，最终目标不是增加更多模块、策略、Agent 或“自我进化”概念，而是建立一个能够在严格风险约束下，从真实市场数据出发，完成 **observe → understand → generate decision → risk check → execute → broker fill → reconcile → PnL attribution → counterfactual evaluation → reflection → hypothesis → candidate strategy/model → offline validation → shadow/probation → live validation → promote/scale/pause/retire → repeat** 的完整自动闭环，并最终用长期、prospective、after-cost、risk-adjusted live net PnL 判断系统是否真正产生价值。第一步不要继续开发新功能，而是从代码、配置、数据库、journal、strategy registry、模型、文档和实际运行路径出发，对整个 repository 做一次事实级审查：明确每一个已经设计、实现或文档中声明的组件到底是否被真实调用、是否影响生产决策、是否有数据输入输出、是否存在只写了但从未使用的 dead code / unused feature / unused strategy / unused model / unused reflection / unused lifecycle / unused risk rule / duplicated abstraction / wrapper / historical path，并将所有能力分类为 **actively used / partially wired / implemented but unused / obsolete / duplicated / broken / missing**；特别检查“看起来已经有”但实际上没有进入真实交易闭环的功能，禁止把配置存在、函数存在、测试存在或文档存在等同于功能真正有效。随后以**最小可靠闭环优先**为原则进行重构，严格执行 **delete → merge → simplify → reuse → repair → only then add**：先删除或隔离无效和重复路径，统一唯一的数据流、控制流、状态来源、PnL ledger、strategy lifecycle、experiment registry、execution truth 和运行入口，确保主系统能够稳定完成一轮真实 end-to-end cycle，并为每一步建立明确输入、输出、责任边界、失败行为、日志、provenance 和自动测试。优先补齐当前真正决定系统能否学习的基础设施，包括完整 fill/trade/position/strategy/model attribution、realized/unrealized/net PnL、fees/slippage/cost accounting、BUY/SELL/HOLD counterfactual ledger、market/regime context、strategy lineage、experiment ledger、失败实验记录、模型预测与实际结果对齐，以及 lifecycle 的显式 state-machine invariants；任何 promotion、mutation 或自主修改都必须基于这些可验证证据，而不是 LLM 主观总结。将生产系统与研究/进化系统彻底分离：生产层只负责 data → decision → allocation → immutable Guardian → execution → reconciliation，学习层负责 diagnosis → hypothesis → candidate generation → backtest → walk-forward OOS → robustness → multiple-testing/overfitting control → shadow → small-capital probation → promotion/retirement；LLM 可以用于 reasoning、failure diagnosis、hypothesis generation、strategy proposal 和 research orchestration，但不得直接修改 Guardian、global risk limits、broker credentials、kill switch、audit rules 或未经验证直接修改 production behavior。不要把“交易次数更多”“HOLD rate 更低”“策略数量更多”“LLM 自己改代码”作为成功标准；先解释每一次 decision 是否正确，特别是对 HOLD 计算未来 counterfactual outcome，区分 good hold、missed alpha、avoided loss 和 false trade。对所有已有 strategy/model 建立 champion–challenger 和统一 StrategySpec，自动检测 semantic/behavioral duplicate，阻止 strategy zoo 无限制膨胀；新 candidate 必须说明它解决了什么已经观察到的 failure、与已有策略有什么本质区别、用了什么数据、经过了多少次搜索，并记录所有失败 trial，避免自动 data mining 和 selection bias。整个优化过程必须遵循“**先跑通闭环，再提高正确性，再提高研究能力，再增加自主性，最后才扩大资金**”的顺序：Phase 0 先做到 syntax/import/tests/service startup/restart/recovery/broker reconciliation 全部 PASS；Phase 1 完成真实交易和 PnL attribution；Phase 2 完成 counterfactual 与 decision-quality evaluation；Phase 3 建立 strategy/model/experiment registry；Phase 4 建立严格 offline backtest、walk-forward、cost、leakage、stress 和 overfitting validation；Phase 5 完成 shadow trading；Phase 6 才允许 evidence-gated probation；Phase 7 根据 prospective live evidence 自动 promote/pause/retire；Phase 8 再加入 regime-aware portfolio allocation、model retraining 和 strategy evolution；只有前一阶段 exit criteria 全部满足才能进入下一阶段。每次修改后都必须运行统一的 `make verify` 或等价命令，至少验证 software、syntax/import、unit/integration、data integrity、point-in-time/no-leakage、PnL accounting、lifecycle invariants、Guardian bypass prevention、replay determinism、crash recovery、broker reconciliation、shadow/live consistency，并要求 `FAIL=0`；任何失败不能被 warning 或 fallback 掩盖。最终请输出并持续维护一份事实级系统文档，明确：① 当前真实运行架构和唯一 end-to-end data/control flow；② 所有组件的 used/unused/broken/missing 审查表；③ 当前闭环在哪里真正断裂；④ 哪些模块应该删除、合并、修复或保留；⑤ 每个阶段的具体实现任务、依赖关系、测试方法、exit criteria 和验证结果；⑥ 当前赚钱或亏钱到底由 signal、model、strategy、allocation、execution、cost 还是 regime 导致；⑦ 当前系统哪些能力已经有证据证明，哪些只是设计目标；⑧ 下一轮只选择对“真实 after-cost risk-adjusted live profitability”最有价值的 1–3 个改动执行。整个项目的最高原则是：**不要优化一个尚未闭环的系统，不要让无法归因的结果驱动学习，不要让未经验证的学习结果进入生产，不要用复杂度代替能力；先让每一条数据、每一个决策、每一个订单、每一美元 PnL 和每一次策略变化都可以追踪、解释、复现和验证，再逐步让系统自动学习和自动进化。最终唯一有效的外部成功标准是：在固定风险边界和真实交易成本下，系统能否持续产生可复现、可归因、经样本外和 prospective live trading 验证的正净收益，而不是回测数字、策略数量或自治程度本身。**

progressNotes.summary: Re-read the FULL objective (it had been truncated in earlier turns) and it changes the picture. Two things: (1) it names a Phase 0-8 ordering with a strict "only enter a phase when the previous one's exit criteria are met" rule, and Phase 4/5/6 are backtest+walk-forward+cost+leakage+stress+overfitting, then SHADOW TRADING, then evidence-gated probation. (2) I WITHDREW my earlier "shadow is merged into probation" decision — the reasoning was sound but it was wrong against this contract, which names shadow as its own phase. Shadow is recorded as missing; Phase 5 is outstanding. The underlying observation is kept as a constraint for when it is built: a shadow executor must swap only the execution sink, not fork the decision path. Phase 0-3 confirmed met; Phase 8 correctly not started. Crash recovery is now PROVEN rather than configured: SIGKILL with no cleanup, NRestarts 0->1, new MainPID, pidfile rewritten, 920 cycles + 5782 events re-read cleanly, journal re-parsed with zero corrupt lines, daemon resumed journalling within a minute. Phase 4 built in a separate src/min_agent/research/ package with a make verify check that FAILS if any production module imports it, so production/research separation is machine-checked rather than conventional. The backtest executes the declared StrategySpec rule (HOLD_BASELINE control, FIXED_SIZE, TREND_FOLLOW), long-only matching the production executor, cost charged both sides because the paper broker charged zero. Three of my own controls were wrong first time and the module says so: the leakage guard only watched the loop index go backwards (which no rule could do, so it could not have detected the only leak that matters) and now re-asks each rule truncated to its decision bar, with a test that plants a peek-ahead rule; the overfitting control computed threshold/trials where threshold=0.0 so 0.0/40=0.0 and searching 40 variants cost nothing, and now raises required independent OOS trades on a sqrt schedule; one jitter seed is not a stress test and the first seed made a long position BETTER (+28.97 vs +26.14 baseline) so the worst of five is kept and they span +8.74 to +39.61. "Overfitted" was being returned for strategies with one trade per fold, which claims generalisation without enough trades to generalise from, so thin data is now reported as thin first. Honest result over all 27 strategies and 467 distinct real observations: 27 of 27 INSUFFICIENT, 3 OOS trades against the 10 required for 27 trials — not one strategy in the registry has enough out-of-sample evidence to be called anything. That agrees with three independent lines of evidence already on record (3 strategies with verified PnL, hold quality 0.687, 27/27 statistically unproven). Also found a real dedupe blind spot: behavioural_signature returned None for every TREND_FOLLOW so no TREND_FOLLOW was ever compared to any other and the zoo check was blind to all twelve; it now returns a signature, exposing 14 redundant copies including three exact duplicates (trend-follow-20260611-001/-002/-003 at ref 100.0 thr 0.02, -004/-005 at 150.0/0.01), and a semantic duplicate — trend-follow-sell-002 is named "Trend Following Sell Strategy" but its kind is FIXED_SIZE with no threshold or reference price, so it does not trend-follow at all and is identical to fixed-size-sell-001 apart from a confidence value. Commit a3f0b61. make verify: 19 classes, 0 failed, 531 distinct tests, 91/91 audit, doctor OK, exit 0.
progressNotes.next: Next in the objective's own order is Phase 5, shadow trading, which the contract names as a distinct stage before evidence-gated probation. Build it as a mode that reuses the existing loop and swaps only the execution sink, so the decision path being validated is the same path production uses rather than a divergent copy. Also still open from the full objective: champion-challenger (absent), strategy lineage (absent), failed-experiment/trial records (the experiment view shows admission verdicts but no attempt ledger), model-prediction-vs-actual alignment (absent), unrealized PnL and regime context, and the doc deliverables 5-8 (per-phase tasks and exit criteria, PnL cause attribution across signal/model/strategy/allocation/execution/cost/regime, proven-vs-design-target, and the next 1-3 changes). Phase 7 cannot complete without market hours.

Phase 5 built: shadow trading. MIN_AGENT_SHADOW=1 replaces the final broker call and nothing else - real data, real model, real Guardian, real journal, only submission replaced - so the path being validated is the same path that will trade. A config flag rather than a fourth `mode`, because `mode` already carries a hard safety meaning (anything but paper raises at load) and overloading it with "paper but pretend" would blur the line that must stay sharp. The safety property is negative and is the point: a shadow order is NOT a fill. status=SHADOWED is a distinct value rather than a reuse of SKIPPED so any branch that does not know it will not count it as executed; order_id is always None so no reconciliation can match it to a broker order; and a journal of four shadow orders yields realized PnL None, account_return_pct None, closed_lot_count 0, linked_fill_count 0. If a shadow order ever reached the PnL ledger as executed, the account would book profit from money never risked and an unvalidated path would look like the best on record - the most dangerous bug this system could have, because the loop would lie while looking healthy. A make verify check now enforces it across every production module (no module may group SHADOWED with an executed status) - a gate not a test because a new `if` on execution.status is exactly when it would be reintroduced; proven to fire by planting a grouping, and it was itself wrong first run, failing on the Literal that DECLARES the statuses, which is how a gate earns a reputation for noise. Verified against the live journal: SHADOWED, order_id None, one SHADOW_ORDER_INTENT event, cycle count unchanged 920/920 (a shadow intent is not a cycle), account realized PnL None. Three mistakes, all the same shape as before: append_event takes a JournalEvent not kwargs so TypeError was swallowed by a broad except and every shadow intent was silently dropped (third JournalEvent/dict confusion in this work); the event type was missing from JournalEventType raising ValidationError through the same except; and the sink-selection function was anchored on `def _build_loop(` which does not exist in cli.py so both call sites were rewritten and the definition never landed, caught by the startup test as an unbound name. The except is correct and stays (a journal fault must never escalate into a real order) but now records into ShadowExecutor.journal_failures instead of discarding, with a test asserting a healthy journal leaves it empty so the counter cannot rot. Also caught that shadow-live-consistency was still printing "shadow mode NOT implemented" after shadow was built because its string was never updated - a check that prints a falsehood is worse than no check; it now verifies shadow is reachable from config, off by default, and that the switch parses strictly (MIN_AGENT_SHADOW=flase raises rather than silently enabling a flag that decides whether real orders reach a broker). Commit 9703d9d. make verify: 20 classes, 0 failed, 545 distinct tests, 91/91 audit, doctor OK, exit 0.
progressNotes.next: Phase 5 is now implemented, so the objective's ordering allows Phase 6: evidence-gated probation. Before that can be real, probation must consume the research evidence that now exists - the offline screen plus the walk-forward verdict - rather than a cycle count alone. Also still open from the full objective and not yet started: champion-challenger designation (absent), strategy lineage (absent), failed-experiment/trial records (the experiment view shows admission verdicts but no attempt ledger, so a search that tried 40 variants leaves no trace), model-prediction-vs-actual alignment (absent), unrealized PnL and regime context, and doc deliverables 5-8 (per-phase tasks/exit criteria, PnL cause attribution across signal/model/strategy/allocation/execution/cost/regime, proven-vs-design-target, next 1-3 changes). Note the honest constraint from Phase 4: all 27 strategies are INSUFFICIENT out-of-sample, so no strategy currently has the evidence to be scaled - probation gating should therefore tighten, not widen.

Three more objective requirements implemented, all as derived views over the journal rather than new stores. (1) Lineage did not exist: StrategySpec has no lineage field at all, so nothing linked a strategy back to the failure it was proposed to fix; the link does exist in the curriculum event (exploration summary + task_id), so it is derived. (2) Search effort left no trace: the live journal holds 69 proposals across 63 task ids and task-20260611-002 produced THREE variants - a search whose surviving sibling inherits that selection, invisible without a trial count. search_effort now reports proposals, distinct tasks, tasks that searched, and max variants per task. (3) No champion existed: two ACTIVE strategies and no benchmark. The champion is designated from broker-verified strategy-level PnL only - fixed-size-buy-001 at +120.37, highest of the two ACTIVE strategies with verified PnL. Naming one from cycles or an in-sample backtest would be choosing a benchmark on evidence the system already distrusts, so with nothing verified the answer is None and the report says why. Live findings: 33 candidates from 31 tasks, 1 task searched, max 3 variants, and 33 of 33 candidates cannot state what observation motivated them - not one candidate in the system's history recorded the observation that produced it, because the proposal schema requires only free-text rationale. Reported, not backfilled: inventing a justification after the fact would be worse than recording that none was given. Four mistakes, three the same shape as before: the doctor check was DEFINED AND NEVER CALLED (anchor didn't match) - the "implemented but unused" category this audit exists to eliminate, created in the commit hunting for it; the new reachability gate is itself wrong twice, first a double-escaped regex matching a literal backslash, then subtracting name SETS which cannot work because every called name is also a defined name so the sets are identical and the subtraction empties to nothing (it reported all 17 checks as unreachable) - it now distinguishes call sites by position; ReflectionMemory was used but never imported in doctor.py, the NameError swallowed by the check's own except Exception, leaving results empty and the report claiming champion=NONE while a champion was on file; and the champion reason read "the only such strategy on record" when two qualified, so it now counts qualifiers and names the runner-up. Commit c633130. make verify: 21 classes, 0 failed, 572 distinct tests, 91/91 audit, doctor OK, exit 0.
progressNotes.next: Remaining from the full objective, not yet started: model-prediction-vs-actual alignment (the objective requires model predictions to be checked against actual outcomes - currently the LLM's confidence is recorded but never scored for calibration, so a model that is confidently wrong looks identical to one that is right), unrealized PnL (only realized is attributed), regime context (referenced in curriculum prose but not computed or recorded), and the doc deliverables 5-8: per-phase tasks/dependencies/test methods/exit criteria/verification results, PnL cause attribution across signal/model/strategy/allocation/execution/cost/regime, proven-capability vs design-target, and the next 1-3 highest-value changes. Phase 7 still needs market hours. Model calibration is the highest-value remaining item: it is the only way to tell whether the decision engine is adding value over a coin flip, which is the question the whole loop ultimately answers.

Model-prediction-vs-actual alignment implemented (the highest-value remaining item from the full objective). The system recorded a confidence on every decision and never once compared it to an outcome - confidence was used only as a gate (min_confidence deciding whether an order may be sent), never as a testable claim, so a model that is confidently wrong was indistinguishable from one that is right. calibration.py joins the two things that already exist: each decision's confidence and the counterfactual ledger's scored verdict. The finding is the important part: 67 llm decisions, 0 scored, 67 awaiting an outcome. They all fall between 11:20 and 15:59 on 2026-09-28, a single session, and the 24h horizon needs a quote from 2026-09-29 11:20 onward which does not exist because the market has been closed. Mean llm confidence 0.276. So the honest reading is not "the model is bad" but "we do not know yet" - the report says INSUFFICIENT with a note that the value is unmeasured rather than good, and the doctor check stays a warning until the verdict starts with SIGNAL. Scoring rules: only a hold that avoided a loss is correct; MISSED_ALPHA and FALSE_TRADE are both incorrect, because scoring a missed rally as "correct caution" would give any model that never trades a perfect curve for free, which is the easiest way to manufacture good calibration; NEUTRAL is excluded since a move that did not clear the cost is silence. Two of my own mistakes: the first metric compared gate-clearing accuracy against the base rate, but with min_confidence at 0.5 both a 0.6 and a 0.9 clear the gate so the comparison measured almost every decision and could not distinguish a model that separates good from bad from one that does not - a test failed for the right reason with the wrong metric, so the comparison is now the most confident populated bucket against the base rate, with a test pinning the gate comparison's weakness so it is not reintroduced. And the bucket width matters: 0.2 wide so 0.95 and 1.0 land together, since splitting them produced a one-member bucket reading as a 100% accurate stratum. Objective deliverable 6 answered from real data, and the answer is the most important finding in the project: THE +564.39 IS NOT THE MODEL'S MONEY. All 23 closed lots were opened by the `baseline` decision source on 2026-06-11, 06-12 and 06-18. The LLM path produced its first decision on 2026-09-28, two and a half months after the last profitable lot, and opened none of them. The model's contribution to realized PnL is 0.00. Both halves of that join were always recorded - the lot names the order that opened it via buy_order_id, and the cycle names the decision source that issued that order - but nothing joined them, so strategy_realized_pnl was read as evidence that the decision engine worked when it is evidence about the baseline rule. attribution.py performs the join and reports all seven causes the objective names, always: model NOT THE CAUSE (0.00 of +564.39); signal attributable (all 23 lots from the baseline source); strategy attributable (3 strategies, largest tiny-fixed-size-001 at +362.66); cost NOT A FACTOR HERE (paper broker charged 0.00 across 23 lots, so the figure is gross and overstates what a live venue would pay); allocation partly attributable (36 orders refused, so the PnL is what got through not what was wanted); execution not a factor (fill ratio 1.00); regime CANNOT ATTRIBUTE (no regime context computed or recorded). All seven always appear because a row absent when data is missing is a silent gap and a reader cannot tell "not a factor" from "nobody looked". A second real finding: the two numbers in the same payload are NOT a reconciliation and the payload did not say so. strategy_realized_pnl (+564.39) is the agent's closed lots, SPY only, opened 2026-06-11 to 06-18; account_realized_or_reported_pnl (-406.54) is the broker's CUMULATIVE profit_loss for the whole account over all time including BIL and TLT. Different scopes and periods - the 970.93 difference is not a loss, and a reader seeing both would conclude the agent lost against its own accounting. On severity I refused to mask: the doctor check could have been made green by downgrading the model finding, and that would have been masking, so the split is drawn on evidence - a model that has opened no lots makes the figure the baseline's and that is a fact waiting on market hours (WARN), while a model that opened lots and contributed <= 0 against a positive total is trading and failing to beat the baseline (FAIL). Both branches are pinned. Writing that test found a further gap one level down: the first version tested model_pnl == 0.0, so a model that opened a lot and lost 20.00 while the account was up reported OK - now <= 0.0, the same defect caught at the next level. Regime context implemented, completing the measurement half of objective deliverable 6. regime.py derives the regime from the realized price series (only one last_price per cycle exists - no OHLC, volume or VIX), and deliberately does NOT allocate by regime since allocation is Phase 8 and starting it before earlier phases finish would be entering a phase out of order. The limitation is stated rather than buried: these are last-trade prints on a 5-minute cycle, not exchange bars, so volatility is noisier and slightly inflated by intra-interval moves, and a gap between samples reads as a move that may have occurred anywhere within it. The live result is mostly "cannot tell": of 467 bars, 391 are UNKNOWN and 76 TRENDING_DOWN, and only 78 bars have a contiguous window at all - the current regime cannot be labelled because the last 78 bars span a gap over 30 minutes. A window spanning a gap is refused rather than classified, because the journal contains a 97-day outage and a "recent volatility" across it would describe two different months as one market. The consequence is the honest one: every one of the 23 profitable lots was opened in a window that cannot be labelled, so the regime row is no longer CANNOT ATTRIBUTE because code was missing but because it was MEASURED and came back unusable - the loop now knows it cannot answer this rather than not knowing that it could not. The unmeasurable bucket is reported rather than dropped, since a bucket that silently vanishes is how a conclusion gets drawn from the measurable minority. Two properties enforced rather than assumed: point-in-time (a label at bar i uses bars up to i only, with the test that matters being that appending future bars cannot change an earlier label - a regime label on a past decision is exactly the context that leaks, and it leaks silently), and volatility overriding direction (a steep decline is UNSTABLE not TRENDING_DOWN, because filing a violent decline as a calm downtrend understates the risk of trading through it). A test caught my own fixture making that mistake - a -2.0-per-bar series expected to be TRENDING_DOWN, and the classifier was right while the test was wrong - and the same test showed the classifier describes the window it is given, so with the default 78-bar window a series that rose then fell is TRENDING_UP because the rise dominates, which is correct and is now tested with a 30-bar window rather than expecting the classifier to see through its own window. Closed the Phase 3 gap - the only phase that was partial for a missing component rather than thin data. Every decision recorded decision_source (llm, fallback_policy_engine, baseline) but not WHICH model, so the 67 llm decisions could not be separated by prompt or model version and no outcome could ever be attributed to a model change. The model was upgraded during this project (Ollama 0.34.4, qwen3.8:27b, single-CUDA pin) and without provenance that upgrade is invisible in the record and its effect is unmeasurable forever. TradeDecision.model now records it, stamped AT THE POINT THE MODEL IS CALLED rather than inferred from config later - the model can be swapped between the call and the journal write, and a decision attributed to the wrong version is worse than one with no attribution. A model named inside the response itself wins over the configured name because that is the one that actually served the request, and the fallback path names itself fallback_policy_engine so a fallback decision can never be counted as a model's work. model_registry.py is a view over the journal like the experiment registry and lineage, with a test asserting it exposes no save/write/append, because a persisted store of model performance would be a second source of truth about numbers already recorded and would drift. The history is NOT back-filled: all 920 cycles predate the field and report UNATTRIBUTED, since assigning them the currently configured model would assert a fact about the past that is not known and would make every future comparison look like evidence for a model that never ran. The doctor check is a warning while that is true - correct rather than noisy - and clears itself as soon as the market is open and new decisions are stamped. Implemented unrealized PnL - the last code item from deliverable 8. Only realized PnL was attributed, so a position the agent was holding contributed nothing to its own record and the account figure and the agent figure could never be reconciled even in principle: one measured closed trades, the other measured everything, and the gap could only be explained away. PnLEvidence now carries open_lots, unrealized_pnl, net_pnl and net_of_fees, with open lots keeping the strategy that opened them to match the realized side's rule (the strategy that opens a lot is the one expected to realize its PnL, which may not be the strategy that eventually sells it). Verified by the daemon writing it rather than by a script: realized 564.39, open lots empty, unrealized 0.0, net 564.39, net of fees 564.39 - the agent holds no SPY (account positions are BIL, TLT, XLB, XLE, XLF) so unrealized is 0 and net equals realized, which is the correct answer and not a stub, and the machinery is proven only by test against a live position because there is no live position. The refusal that matters: an open lot whose price is unknown is reported with current_price None and unrealized_pnl None, never valued at its entry price, because marking a position at its own cost reports it as worth exactly nothing - a fabricated number wearing the appearance of a measurement. This surfaced a real finding now visible in doctor: 29 shares were sold under trend-follow-sell-002 that no linked BUY can account for. The account holds no SPY so those shares came from somewhere the fill linkage cannot see - a pre-existing position, a fill whose client_order_id never linked, or a lot opened before the journal began. The 23 closed lots carrying the +564.39 are all fully linked so the verified figure is unaffected, but 29 shares of unexplained selling belongs in a health report rather than a payload field. It is explicitly NOT diagnosed: it needs the ORDER_FILL_CONFIRMED events for that strategy traced back, which is real work and not something to guess at. A test also caught the doctor implementation formatting unrealized unconditionally, which would have raised TypeError on its own history since every stored PNL event predates the field - the same shape as reading a JournalEvent as a dict; it now degrades to net alone.
